headline: Border Commanders Conclude Two-Day Talk By Mutually Agreeing To Keep Their Respective Tiffin Boxes Secret
body:
“I’ve been watching the binoculars for forty-eight hours, and they didn’t discuss maps once—they spent the entire time comparing the structural integrity of their respective plastic containers,” said a local high-altitude yak herder.

“The silence from the summit is deafening, but personally, I think they’re just trying to figure out which one of them has the better recipe for paneer,” remarked a nearby mountain-pass chai shop owner.

“My commander told me the two-day delay was strictly to negotiate the exchange rate of homemade pickles for extra parathas, and frankly, that’s the kind of diplomacy I can support,” noted an unnamed border patrol junior engineer.

“It’s a massive relief that the talks were held over forty-eight hours because anything shorter would have meant one of them didn't get to finish their dessert,” added a curious local logistics delivery rider.

“I’ve seen them looking at each other through the fog, and it’s clearly less about territory and more about who brought the superior brand of instant coffee to the base camp,” observed a roaming wildlife photographer.
caption: Diplomacy is just two people waiting for the other to offer the last bite of a samosa. #IndiaChina #BorderTalks #TiffinDiplomacy #Geopolitics (satire)
